projects.name: Project
details: • GEN AI - RATE ANALYSIS (JUN 2024 - FEB 2025)
◦ Developed a solution for plastic injection Molding machine for Motherson Automotive Technologies
and Engineering (MATE), chennai. Using computer vision and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated
BRIEF) feature descriptor, compare live feed image and reference image to instruct the molding ma- chine to start the next cycle or to terminate next cycle and terminate the production.
Relevant Activities :
* Document conversion, Llama-parser for document chunking. Document embedding (Azure em- bedding, Hypo embedding). Model - "Text-embedding ada-002". Python.
* Document indexing (Langchain), FAISS vector DB, Azure Blob storage.
* Angular, Web API, SQL Server, Langchain OPENAI (LLM).
